source: read-only pg_catalog.pg_opclass complete to_jsonb(c)::text tuple plus pg_opfamily, pg_am, pg_amop and pg_amproc references
semantic_review: For every visible class read complete catalog tuple, identity, source hash, index AM, input and key type, family, default/owner, operator and support-function presence; interpreted class-specific semantics including pg_trgm, JSONB path, network, BRIN Bloom/minmax/inclusion, geometry, range/multirange, TS query cross-type behavior and text pattern. Not native algorithm implementation or benchmark.
limitations: Provider exposes catalog declarations, not C/internal native implementations or planner execution
63 potentially sensitive GUC values and provider console-only configuration intentionally withheld
safety: Read-only provider catalog, no user/Auth/member records, credentials, logs or production write
